name: Multi-file — file upload + parser
diff:
diff --git a/upload_handler.go b/upload_handler.go
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/upload_handler.go
@@ -0,0 +1,17 @@
+package main
+
+import (
+	"io"
+	"net/http"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+)
+
+func upload(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
+	name := r.URL.Query().Get("name")
+	path := filepath.Join("/uploads", name)
+	data, _ := io.ReadAll(r.Body)
+	f, _ := os.Create(path)
+	f.Write(data)
+	f.Close()
+}
diff --git a/parser.go b/parser.go
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/parser.go
@@ -0,0 +1,13 @@
+package main
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"strconv"
+)
+
+func parse(s string) int {
+	n, _ := strconv.Atoi(s)
+	value := 100 / n
+	fmt.Printf("parsed %d\n", value)
+	return value
+}
